plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, an inked molecular and gastric-irritation comparison chart from Hoffmann's 10 August 1897 notebook shows salicylic acid (exposed phenolic −OH group irritating stomach mucosa) vs acetylsalicylic acid (acetyl group −COCH3 shielding the stomach before releasing active salicylate in the bloodstream).

teach_overlay.label: 10 AUG 1897 ACETYLATION: SALICYLIC ACID (−OH) + ACETIC ANHYDRIDE → ACETYLSALICYLIC ACID (−OCOCH3)
teach_overlay.detail: Inked molecular & gastric-irritation comparison chart on period paper from Hoffmann's 10 August 1897 notebook showing salicylic acid (exposed phenolic −OH group irritating stomach mucosa) vs acetylsalicylic acid (acetyl group −COCH3 shielding the stomach before releasing active salicylate in the bloodstream)
teach_overlay.scale: swapping a single hydrogen atom for an acetyl group turned a corrosive crystal that burned the throat into a gentle tablet that passed safely through the stomach
